info.title: Sparks of Tomorrow (ITA)
info.synopsis: Le vicende si svolgono nell’estate del 1907, 40° anno dell’era Meiji, periodo in cui il Giappone apre le porte al mondo occidentale, così che anche l’elettricità inizia ad arrivare nelle città giapponesi. Inako Momokawa è una ragazzina di 15 anni che vive a Fushimi, nell’area di Kyoto, ed è la seconda figlia di un produttore di sakè. Non riesce assolutamente mai a combinarne una giusta, venendo rimproverata dal padre ogni singolo giorno, trovando sollievo solo quando prega gli dei. Un giorno al Santuario di Fushimi Inari però incontra Kihachi Sakamoto, un giovane spirito libero che non crede negli dei e che non vede l’ora che arrivi la nuova era dell’elettricità. Improvvisamente, a casa di Inako si comincia a parlare di matrimonio. Il padre come al solito fa ogni scelta, mentre Inako è sempre più vicina ad arrendersi al suo destino, ma ecco che Kihachi la convince a fuggire via da casa. L’unico modo per impedire il matrimonio è trovare un libro chiamato “Il Catalogo dell’Elettricità”, scritto da Kihachi ma preso da suo fratello Seiroku. Inako e Kihachi viaggiano insieme per ritrovarlo tra le prefetture di Kyoto e Shiga.

episodes.title: The Electric Boy
episodes.synopsis: Early 20th-century Kyoto. Kihachi witnesses the wonders of electricity with Seiroku. Four years later, alone and cynical, he meets a girl deep in prayer.

episodes.title: The Mysteries of the Catalog
episodes.synopsis: In a haze of incense, Yosuke storms into Kihachi's workshop and demands the Catalog — and his fiancée. But why does Inako have it in the first place?

episodes.title: Their Dream
episodes.synopsis: Full of denial, Yosuke clashes with Kihachi. Later, Inako's sharp senses reveal a secret and her belief inspires Kihachi to recreate an invention.

episodes.title: The Steadfast Girl
episodes.synopsis: Inako meets a grieving shop owner whose loss echoes her own. Fully believing in Kihachi's skills, she asks him to build an electric machine to help.

episodes.title: Proof of Love
episodes.synopsis: Kihachi's latest experiment catches the eye of a strange university graduate, who's convinced that it can help him prove his passion to his crush.

episodes.title: The Sound of Innovation
episodes.synopsis: Yosuke challenges Kihachi and the gang to a music battle. With only Inako having musical experience, can they master electric instruments in a week?

episodes.title: Elopement
episodes.synopsis: On the day of Inako's engagement ceremony, Kihachi urges her to chase her dreams and helps her escape. Guided by Stuart's letter, they head for Shiga.

episodes.title: His Brother`s Footsteps
episodes.synopsis: Before Kihachi can figure out how to fix the electric key, Kengo breaks down and confesses the secret he's been carrying for the past three years.

episodes.title: Time to Part
episodes.synopsis: Kihachi makes a shocking decision to protect Inako, but she takes matters into her own hands. Yosuke reminisces about his first meeting with Seiroku.

episodes.title: Engagement Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Yosuke makes a critical discovery. After Inako and Kihachi clear up their misunderstanding, they help Kengo reconcile with Noriko using a shocking plan.

episodes.title: The Enticing Circuit
episodes.synopsis: After Inako and Saki sneak into Yosuke's office to find clues about the Electric Brocade, Kihachi vanishes. Inako realizes that her father holds the key.

episodes.title: Electric Brain
episodes.synopsis: Inako and Kihachi throw themselves into pursuing their dreams. Determined to fulfill Seiroku's vision, Yosuke ropes Kihachi into a colossal project.

episodes.title: To the Future We Desire
episodes.synopsis: As the Electric Brain goes berserk, Kihachi, Inako and Yosuke confront their destinies. Who will stay stuck in the past or look towards the future?
